name: How long does window replacement take for an average home?

mainEntity.name: How long does window replacement take for an average home?

acceptedAnswer.text: For an average home, replacing all windows typically takes one to three days, depending on the number of windows, their size, the type of installation (full-frame or insert), and any unexpected structural issues. Smaller projects with just a few windows might be completed in a single day. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption while ensuring a high-quality, airtight installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Window replacement for an average home usually takes 1-3 days, depending on the number of windows and installation complexity.
